clarification_title: H39 Overlapping Outcome Serial Dependence and Robust Inference Clarification

rationale_and_mechanism.serial_dependence_cause: Adjacent forward-return intervals overlap mechanically by 3 decision slots for 60m and 15 decision slots for 240m. Ordinary iid standard errors and classical chi-square tests assume independent residuals and understate variance under overlapping sampling.
rationale_and_mechanism.scientific_integrity_attestation: Zero post-start validation performance or outcomes were inspected prior to selecting the estimator. All lag, block, and bootstrap choices are deterministic mathematical functions of sampling cadence and label horizon, never tuned on data.

primary_60m_linear_inference.model: OLS regression with intercept: y_t = beta_0 + beta_1 * x_t + e_t
primary_60m_linear_inference.kernel: Bartlett triangular kernel: w(l, L) = 1 - l / (L + 1)
primary_60m_linear_inference.formal_holm_family_input: HAC one-sided raw p-values across M1-M8
primary_60m_linear_inference.candidate_significance_threshold: Holm-adjusted HAC p-value < 0.05 and 95% HAC CI excludes zero in positive direction
primary_60m_linear_inference.iid_statistics_status: Retained strictly as labeled diagnostics; prohibited from candidate gating

incremental_baseline_inference.regularization_strength: lambda = 1.0 (equivalent to C = 1.0, intercept unpenalized, no tuning)

microstructure_coefficient_uncertainty.kernel: Bartlett triangular kernel, fixed lag L = 3
microstructure_coefficient_uncertainty.hessian: H = X' W X + Lambda, where W = diag(p_t * (1 - p_t))
microstructure_coefficient_uncertainty.score_covariance: S_NW computed on score vectors u_t = (y_t - p_t) * X_t with Bartlett weights up to lag 3

nested_likelihood_ratio_calibration.resampling_scheme: Under H0, hold (X_base, y) fixed to preserve baseline joint temporal dependence; draw overlapping blocks of length 4 from x_micro with replacement to form surrogate x_micro*; compute LR* across 5000 replications
nested_likelihood_ratio_calibration.fail_closed_policy: If robust LR bootstrap cannot execute with deterministic convergence, fail closed to STATISTICAL_INFERENCE_NOT_READY; do not fall back to classical chi-square iid p-values

supporting_240m_linear_inference.kernel: Bartlett triangular kernel: w(l, L) = 1 - l / (L + 1)
supporting_240m_linear_inference.gating_impact: None (primary candidate decisions strictly use 60m HAC and bootstrap evidence)

contamination_attestation.statement: Zero fresh post-start 60m or 240m validation outcomes were inspected, evaluated, or materialized before this clarification manifest was committed to git.
